notes.title: Fallen Knight Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone is staying healthy and well! After speaking with the community and receiving feedback we have made some adjustments to Lancelot's heal! For more details do read below.

Fallen Knight Patch 1.05 Update

 Lancelot is now allowed to heal himself whilst moving and holding the heal button (applies after ≈2.5 secs). This applies to all movement; running, dashing, jumping, wall running, etc. 
 Idle/sitting healing speed has been reduced from 2 secs to 1.5 secs (Focus Heal has been adjusted as well).
 Reduced "Double Heal" unlock criteria from 500HP to 50HP.
 Fixed and improved Japanese localization.
 Fixed bug where previously players are unable to press any button at the "Results" screen after defeating Lucifer.


Still finding bugs? Help report them ♥

notes.title: Q.O.L Improvements Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone has had a wonderful week and has enjoyed the update from Patch 1.0.1. We appreciate the constant feedback and the support as always. Please find the updates that have already been released with our hotfix patches throughout the previous week and also find what we are currently working on below ♥

Hotfixes Released Last Week

 Improve character controls and controller input
 Fix "Retry" issue (where some parts of the game, when selecting "Retry" it bugs out


Upcoming Q.O.L Improvement Updates

 Camera adjustment (where sometimes when Lancelot moves too fast the camera doesn't catch up)
 Add PC resolution setting and Windowed Mode
 Adjust consistency for "Parry & Disarm" for each enemy type and boss
 Possible addition to add Honor Points when killing enemies
 Fix missing UI for tutorial when obtaining new abilities
 Wall hang input may be adjusted to allow players better control on when they want to climb walls
 Investigating issues with some players not receiving achievements after meeting all conditions.

notes.title: HotFix Patch 1.0.1 LIVE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! ♥

Thank you for your patience and support. Please find the Hotfix Patch 1.0.1 now LIVE and ready for your game to be updated!

Hotfix Patch 1.0.1

 Added “No Damage” checkpoint at every Boss room (Players who get through a stage without taking any damage and reach the Boss room will retain “No Damage” status saved at the checkpoint)
 Adjusted Boss Parry & Disarm tutorial screen (5 seconds to read the information before entering Boss room)
 Fixed controller input lag / delay
 Fixing issue with UI shown for Wrath of God in the tutorial
 Fixed Juggernaut’s level where some players were unable to climb the wall on the left
 Fixed when restarting in the Juggernaut level some players would fall through the map
 Fixed Whisper’s level where some platforms cannot be climbed by players
 Fixed Pierrot, Strike and drones that always shoot projectiles towards the floor
 Fixed Driller enemy charge attack speed (before was very slow)
 Fixed where after completing the game and the credits the cutscene didn't show
 Fixed "Purchase" button in the shop (previous was small)
 Fixed where "
" shows up in some texts
 Fixed the SFX bug where the sound still played after being turned off
 Fixed Chain Assassination 2.0 and Chain 2.0 (Previously, players were sometimes unable to execute the move)
 Fixed Wrath of God 1.0/20 (previously was unable to be purchased and also disappears in the customization tab)
 Fixed Boss Rush Mode, best time won't reset after deleting save file
 Fixed issue with achievements (Players that purchase all abilities/Golden Knight now receive Excalibur)
 Fixed Golden Knight achievement description
 Fixed conditions of Excalibur
 Fixed Strike where sometimes after when he starts his dash he would suddenly stop
 Fixed Successor skill cost (previously different cost in Main Story and Boss Rush Mode)
 Fixed Galahad’s bug where he was unable to move when his dagger hits an enemy or boss
 Fixed Pierrot and Nikolai (Previously, the bosses sometimes get stuck during the boss fights)
 Improved Strike’s and Lucifer’s move set during the boss fights
 Improved the Parry & Disarm mechanic (Increased the time window to parry the enemy’s attacks)

notes.title: Futuristic Side-Scroller Fallen Knight Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png

In this fast-paced futuristic knights tale, play as the descendant of the fabled Sir Lancelot in an armoured throw-down of the ages to shield your city from The Purge.

Lancelot the 50th has sworn an oath to protect the 'truth' from an evil organisation and must face off against six unique enemy heroes with a dark past of their own.

Introducing 'The Juggernaught' - The Lord Of Blast

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d254d2b76d98e336f022fba9318adcca55550747.gif

A tough opponent - you must use everything you've learned to conquer this enemy. 
Dash, jump & slash your way to success with lightening-fast reflexes. Landing a well timed dodge is key to defeating this challenger, use your agility to contrast his brute strength.

Earn honour points to upgrade your abilities, health and attacks. This can be a crucial tactic to obtain your success and become unstoppable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/a6e500e0edfb4549772a92904f1d27a49a65880a.gif

All is not what it seems with your opponents, learn about their past and motives as you cut your way through your quest and uncover the reality of The Purge.

Each boss is a unique battle, master your techniques and achieve the honour & glory worthy of a knight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/45897cdb73ae16411d42bf8653529fb6ede15c1c.gif

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

Make sure to keep up to date with Fallen Knight by adding to your wishlist on steam, or by  visiting our website.

Fallen Knight will be coming to PC on 23rd June, 2021.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378370/Fallen_Knight/
